paper.title_en: Transport Coefficients and Conformality Breaking in the Two-Flavor PNJL Model
paper.abstract_en: Based on the two-flavor PNJL model, we self-consistently solve the gap equations and thermodynamic quantities on a dense $(T,{{\mu }_{{\text{B}}}})$ grid, revealing the coupling between non-conformality ($c_{s}^{2}$, $\Theta _{\mu }^{\mu }{\kern 1pt} /{\kern 1pt} {{T}^{4}}$) and transport coefficients. The ratio $\eta {\kern 1pt} /{\kern 1pt} s$ forms a robust valley along ${{T}_{{\text{c}}}}({{\mu }_{{\text{B}}}})$, while $\zeta {\kern 1pt} /{\kern 1pt} s$ develops a ridge at moderate ${{\mu }_{{\text{B}}}}$, coinciding with the softness band. A Kubo-compatible relaxation-time scheme and a compact three-parameter fit $({{\tau }_{0}},{{\kappa }_{{\text{P}}}},\delta {{T}_{{\text{c}}}})$ are proposed for viscous hydrodynamic calibration at RHIC-NICA-FAIR energies and CEP-oriented phenomenology.
